a: भामिन् — a. 1 Passionate, angry. --2 Shining. --3 Handsome, beautiful.

m: भामिनी (इनी), f. a beautiful woman, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
N. of the daughter of a Gandharva, MārkP.
भामिनी (ई), f. an angry or passionate woman, vixen (often used as a term of endearment = चण्डी, मानिनी, and not always separable from 1. भामिनी), BhP.
a: भामिनी — 1 A beautiful young woman; (कामिनी); R. 8. 28. --2 A passionate woman (often used like चंडी as a term of endearment); उपचीयत एव कापि शोभा परितो भामिनि ते मुखस्य नित्यं Bv. 2. 1. --Comp. --विलासः N. of a poem by Jagannātha Paṇḍita.

k.v: सुन्दरी रमणी रामा कोपना सैव भामिनी। वरारोहा मत्तकाशिन्युत्तमा वरवर्णिनी॥

m: भामिनी-विलास m. N. of a poem by Jagannātha Paṇḍita-rāja (the 1st ch. contains allegorical precepts, the 2nd amatory subjects, the 3rd an elegy on a wife's death, the 4th teaches that consolation is only attainable through worshipping Kṛṣṇa).
भामित mfn. enraged, angry, RV.; TS.
